description: Resumable tracker for the webauthn-server-buildkit v2.3.0 polish: dependency verification, full security/correctness/completeness audit + fixes, FULL attestation verification with FIDO MDS, regression tests, docs, and npm release. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on. Re-running the originating prompt MUST read this file and resume from the first non-complete sub-task — never restart from scratch.

userDecisions.attestation: FULL attestation + FIDO MDS trust anchoring for all formats (apple, fido-u2f, packed-x5c, android-key, tpm, android-safetynet/Play Integrity). Multi-session. Keep package offline-by-default and lean: in-house minimal DER reader + Node crypto.X509Certificate for chains; bundle only the small static Apple WebAuthn Root CA; expose a pluggable MetadataService/trust-anchor provider so the RP supplies the large FIDO MDS blob (no bundling/fetching at import). One small vetted ASN.1 dependency pre-approved ONLY if TPM/Android-key parsing is infeasible in-house.
userDecisions.tests: APPROVED to add regression tests for the security work + the currently-untested authentication path (overrides the standing no-tests-unless-asked rule, scoped to this work).
userDecisions.compatibility: Secure-by-default: new protections ON by default, documented as CHANGELOG upgrade notes. Provide config switches to restore legacy behavior where a default change could break existing integrations.
userDecisions.versioning: Minor 2.3.0. Document upgrade notes for behavior changes (challenge lifecycle enforcement, alg pinning at auth, crossOrigin rejection, new VerifiedAuthenticationInfo/VerifiedRegistrationInfo fields).

knownRisks: Full attestation + FIDO MDS is large; sequence simplest-first (apple -> fido-u2f -> packed-x5c -> android-key -> tpm -> android-safetynet), each independently committable.
Secure-by-default behavior changes may require existing integrations to adjust — mitigated with config switches + documented upgrade notes.
TPM/android-safetynet may need a vetted ASN.1/JWT dependency if in-house parsing is infeasible (user pre-approved one small dependency).
android-safetynet is deprecated by Google (Play Integrity successor) — implement for completeness, recommend Play Integrity in docs.
npm token previously expired — publish may need a fresh token + explicit --userconfig/always-auth (see memory npm-publish-token-expired).
commitPolicy: ONE commit per completed+verified phase (green checkpoint), tracker + progress update included in the same commit. Push after committing (authorized by project CLAUDE.md). npm publish requires explicit user confirmation at Phase 8.

baseline.note: All 11 deps already at latest stable (cbor-x 1.6.4, @types/node 25.9.1, vitest+coverage 4.1.7, eslint 10.4.0, eslint-config-prettier 10.1.8, eslint-plugin-prettier 5.5.5, prettier 3.8.3, tsup 8.5.1, typescript 6.0.3, typescript-eslint 8.60.0).

apple: chain to Apple WebAuthn Root CA; nonce ext OID 1.2.840.113635.100.8.2 == hash(authData||clientDataHash); leaf key == credential key
fido-u2f: reconstruct U2F sig base; verify ES256 with attestation cert; chain validate
packed-x5c: verify sig with leaf key; cert requirements; AAGUID ext OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.45724.1.1.4 == authData AAGUID; chain via MDS
android-key: leaf key == credential key; Android Key Attestation ext OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.11129.2.1.17 (challenge==clientDataHash); chain to Google roots
tpm: certInfo (TPMS_ATTEST) + pubArea (TPMT_PUBLIC) parse; pubArea==credential key; extraData==hash(attToBeSigned); AIK cert SAN/EKU; chain
android-safetynet: JWS verify chain to GlobalSign; nonce; ctsProfileMatch; timestamp. Document Play Integrity as preferred successor.

runHistory.summary: Confirmed v2.2.0 polish complete + published. Established green baseline (166 tests). Verified all 11 deps already at latest stable. Ran fresh deep audit (general-purpose agent) finding NEW issues beyond v2.2.0's 16: SEC-N1 stored-challenge never validated (replay), SEC-N2/N3 alg not pinned at auth, SEC-N4 crossOrigin unchecked, SEC-N5 BE/BS+UV downgrade, FUNC-N1 userHandle unvalidated/undiscarded webAuthnUserID, plus correctness/API/hygiene items + a full per-format attestation spec. Confirmed 3 scope decisions with user (full attestation+MDS, tests approved, secure-by-default). Invoked skills: security-review, security-best-practices, nodejs-best-practices, vitest. Scaffolded resumable plan: overview, findings, tracker, progress, 8 phase files.

Dependency verification: confirmed all 11 deps at latest stable (no bumps needed — refreshed during v2.2.0 today). yarn install --immutable clean (no lockfile drift). No banned deps; only cbor-x in production; engine >=24.13.0, pm yarn@4.14.1 intact. Formatted the new plan files (prettier) so format:check is repo-wide clean. Gate green. Phase 0 + Phase 1 committed together as the first green checkpoint.
